newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EA-Generali to make final CA bid.
newsitem.headline: EA-Generali to make final CA bid.

text.p: Insurer EA-Generali said on Thursday a consortium of banking and industrial interests it leads would make a final offer for Austrian sell-off candidate Creditanstalt by Monday, the government's final deadline.

"The consortium led by EA-Generali will make an offer before the deadline expires," chief executive Dietrich Karner told reporters after a hastily-convened meeting of the group, one day after an eleventh-hour bid by Bank Austria.
Karner said the meeting was still underway at the insurer's central Vienna headquarters. "We believe our offer will be quite interesting," he added.

The group was widely expected to be forced into upping its original bid for about two thirds of the government's 70 voting stake in Creditanstalt at some 720-730 schillings ($67.26) a share after Thursday's last-minute bid by Bank Austria.

The bank, Austria's market leader, has reportedly offered 16 billion schillings for the entire stake, which would work out at some 804 schillings a share -- about ten percent above their current market value.
Karner added it was likely the group's updated offer would again be for a large part of the government's share package in cash, while offering to sell the rest in a secondary offering.
